name: "Honeymoon" to Mt. Kilimanjaro
personal_note: We have plans to do weekend trips after the wedding....but to celebrate our "honeymoon" around our 1 yr anniversary (Fall 2027 or Jan 2028)! We decided to space it out to allow for training :), trip planning focus, and to give us something to look forward to & celebrate! This trip will require airfare and tour guide fees/accommodations--so any contributions will help to support our endeavor!
